candidate.intake_requirements: Not confirmed. Ask about parole approval, curfew and waitlist.

candidate.name: Center Point Inc. - Oakland

need.why: No income yet while job searching. CalFresh and General Assistance would cover food and basic costs.

candidate.name: CalFresh (apply via GetCalFresh)
candidate.description: Online CalFresh (food benefits on an EBT card) application in about 10 minutes. Ask for expedited processing; ID and income proof can follow after applying. Prior drug felony convictions do not bar eligibility in California.
candidate.intake_requirements: County interview; proof of identity, income and expenses (can be submitted after applying). Marcus has state ID and SSN card.
candidate.who_it_serves: Low-income Californians, including people recently released
candidate.reason: Low-income Oakland resident, recently released, no income yet. The listing says prior drug felonies don't bar eligibility, and he has ID and an SSN card.

recommendations.why_it_fits: Marcus has no income while he looks for work, so CalFresh with expedited processing can put food money on an EBT card quickly. He already has the ID and SSN card it asks for.

candidate.name: Alameda County General Assistance (GA)
candidate.description: Cash aid for Alameda County adults with no other means of support. Apply online or at an SSA office such as Eastmont Town Center in Oakland. GA cash is treated as a loan under the application's reimbursement agreement, so read that before signing.
candidate.who_it_serves: Alameda County resident adults without dependent children
candidate.reason: He is an Alameda adult with no dependents and is job searching. But he lives with his sister, and support from her could affect whether he has 'no other means of support.' The aid is also treated as a loan.
candidate.confirm_question: Does his sister provide free room and board, and would that count as support that reduces or blocks GA?

recommendations.why_it_fits: General Assistance could cover basic costs until his first paycheck. Ask first whether staying with his sister counts as support, and read the repayment terms before signing.

candidate.name: Clipper START (50% transit fare discount)
candidate.description: Gives adults a discount on single-ride fares across Bay Area transit systems. Apply at clipperstartcard.com. Proof of income can be an EBT card, Medi-Cal card or county benefits letter, so applying for CalFresh first helps. Check the site for current rules, because the source describes the pilot years ago.
candidate.intake_requirements: Age 19-64, Bay Area resident, household income up to 200% of the federal poverty level; proof of income such as an EBT card or Medi-Cal card
candidate.reason: He is a Bay Area resident with no current income, and transportation is one of his barriers. Age isn't in his profile, and the listing's rules may be out of date.
candidate.confirm_question: Is Marcus between 19 and 64, and does he have an EBT or Medi-Cal card to prove income yet?

recommendations.why_it_fits: Transportation is one of his barriers, and Clipper START cuts transit fares in half once he has an EBT or Medi-Cal card to show as proof of income.
what_to_bring: EBT card or Medi-Cal card (once received)

candidate.reason: Serves people on parole or returning from incarceration. Marcus is on parole and was released 26 days ago, and the clinic is in Oakland.
